Date........... 10. 3. 29
Central Station.）

March 8th, 1929.

REPORT ON 'Re attached report.

Made by D. S. Barton, Forwarded by Godfrey C.I.

Mr. Skuse was interviewed at his office in the Customs Building at about 2 p.m., March 2nd, 1929.

He stated that the information he had received from his informer, was not full enough to report to the Police. The informer did not state where the pirates could be found, whether they were in Chinese Territory, French Concession or Settlement, but said he could give the information of a gang of Pirates, who were going to pirate a ship between Shanghai and Swatow if he was paid a big reward, but was afraid to meet any member of the Police.

Mr. Skuse said that he would speak to his informer and should he learn anything further he would report direct to Police Headquarters.

中央捕房。）

1929年3月8日。

关于“附呈报告”的报告。

由 D. S. Barton 撰写，由 Godfrey C.I. 转呈。

1929年3月2日下午2时许，在海关大楼斯库斯先生的办公室对其进行了问话。

他表示，他从线人那里获得的情报尚不充分，不足以向警方报告。该线人并未说明海盗的藏身之处，即他们是在华界、法租界还是公共租界，但称若能支付高额赏金，他可以提供一伙海盗的情报，这伙海盗计划在上海与汕头之间的航线上劫掠船只，但他害怕与任何警务人员会面。

斯库斯先生表示，他将与其线人交谈，若获悉进一步消息，将直接向警务处总部报告。

Ab Barton
D. S.

page_data.en:
Mr. Skuse of the Customs House who has recently
given information about Pirates stated that the most
recent reports from his informer is to the effect that
the pirates have left Shanghai, probably by the
"Kwang Lee". Mr. Skuse adds that the informer is
unwilling to meet any member of the Police or even to
see himself. When the report was previously received
about this matter, D.S. Burton was told off to make
enquiries.

7.3.29.

page_data.zh:
海关的斯库斯先生最近提供了有关海盗的情报，他称其线人提供的最新情报大意是海盗已离开上海，可能是乘坐“广利”轮离开的。斯库斯先生补充说，该线人不愿与任何警务人员会面，甚至不愿与他本人见面。此前收到关于此事的报告时，曾指派高级警探伯顿进行调查。

1929年3月7日。
